phrases.known: Can you give me an interesting book?

phrases.known: I read an interesting book on Sunday
phrases.target: 日曜日に面白い本を読みました

phrases.known: She gave me an interesting book about something else

phrases.known: Do you think this is an interesting book about Japanese?
phrases.target: これは日本語についての面白い本だと思いますか？
